config.simpleshulkerpreview.title: Simple Shulker Preview
config.simpleshulkerpreview.disableMod.t: Turns the preview icon and capacity bar on or off globally for all supported containers (Shulker Boxes, Bundles, etc.).
config.simpleshulkerpreview.showPreviewI: Universal on/off for the preview icon itself (independent of the capacity bar).
config.simpleshulkerpreview.supportBundl: Toggles whether preview icons should be rendered on Bundles.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.supportOther: Toggles whether preview icons and capacity bars should be rendered on unknown modded containers.
Determines which item from inside the container is chosen to be displayed as the primary preview icon on the outside.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.customName.t: Renaming a container to an item ID (e.g., 'diamond') forces that item to be the preview. 'Hide Icons Unless Named' disables normal content scanning, meaning no icon shows on un-named containers.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.category.vis: Tweaking how and where the overlay appears.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.showCapacity: When off, hides the Capacity Bar and any of its settings.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.group.capaci: Note: The capacity bar on Bundles is controlled by vanilla Minecraft and is not affected by these settings.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.hideWhenNoIc: Ties the Capacity Bar visibility to the preview icon visibility.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.group.iconPo: Adjusts the X/Y coordinates and scale of the preview icon. Drag the sliders to see the icon move in real-time.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.overrideBund: Override the position and scale of the Preview Icon Bundles
config.simpleshulkerpreview.group.overri: Stacked Shulker Icon Position & Size Override
config.simpleshulkerpreview.overrideStac: Override the position and scale for stacked shulkers (non-vanilla)
config.simpleshulkerpreview.groupEnchant: Treats enchanted and non-enchanted items as completely separate items when grouping container contents. This affects whether they pass the Minimum Threshold, and whether they are considered 'Unique' or 'Most' abundant.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.group.stackS: An item type must have at least this many total items inside the container to be considered eligible for the preview icon. Calculated as: (Minimum Item Stack Count × Minimum Slot Count).
config.simpleshulkerpreview.group.shulke: Used to calculate the capacity bar percentage for Shulker Boxes. Only change this if you have a mod that alters the standard 3x9 Shulker Box size. Does not affect Bundles.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.translateX.t: The horizontal offset of the icon, from left to right.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.translateY.t: The vertical offset of the icon, from top to bottom.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.direction.to: Direction the capacity bar fills up.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.displayShado: Display a shadow below the capacity bar (typically when laying horizontally).
config.simpleshulkerpreview.length.toolt: Length of the capacity bar, in the direction it will fill up.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.width.toolti: Width of the capacity bar, perpendicular to the direction it will fill up.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.capacityBarX: Distance from the upper left corner to start drawing the bar horizontally.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.capacityBarY: Distance from the upper left corner to start drawing the bar vertically.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.hideWhenEmpt: Hide the capacity bar when the shulker is empty.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.hideWhenFull: Hide the capacity bar when the shulker is full.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.minStackSize: Minimum stack size required for an icon to be displayed.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.minStackCoun: Minimum number of partial stacks required for an icon to be displayed. Multiplier of minimum stack size.
config.simpleshulkerpreview.shulkerInven: For modded shulker boxes with custom sizes. This helps correctly calculate the capacity bar's fill percentage.
For modded shulker boxes with custom sizes. This helps correctly calculate the capacity bar's fill percentage.
